verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's Retention report is explicitly built to measure engagement over time (mixpanel-docs-3), and cohorts/behavioral segments can be defined via event/user properties (mixpanel-docs-16) and queried via the API (mixpanel-docs-39), enabling slicing retention by cohort. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence specifically validating retention+cohort slicing UX in practice (community evidence covers Flow/funnels, not retention).
